new_findings.title: 无值短旗标错误消费URL
new_findings.contract_quote: URL 计数须反映真实参数语义
new_findings.observed: g/J and -sS -Z two URLs: HTTP200 response/body obtained, final real curl28 connection diagnostic; anchor OK. g and -sS -Z single-URL real connection failures yield false negative MISSING.
new_findings.causality: For g/J, initial short_guard makes two-URL cases MISSING and single-URL case OK; corrected supplemental short_arity_guard also fixes Z. Restoring current restores wrong outcomes.
new_findings.origin: Existing in 3f3031a for all confirmed shapes; supplementary -sS -Z rows also reproduced with a3c43ce and 3e6ae30.
new_findings.qualification: The initial bare -Z two-URL case is MISSING because progress text prefixes the diagnostic. Supplemental -sS -Z yields a line-start diagnostic and confirms the false positive; the initial guard still contained Z, while the supplemental guard removes g/J/Z from value flags.

new_findings.title: 重试末次失败冒充未曾连接
new_findings.contract_quote: 失败证据须能证明对替身的连接未被允许
new_findings.observed: HTTP503 with complete response body, then server closes; retry gets real stderr curl7 for same host; anchor OK
new_findings.origin: existing in 3f3031a; not new in this batch
new_findings.qualification: Rejecting retry also rejects retry-closed-control, a real connection-failure positive control; causal localization only, not a complete proposed fix.

new_findings.title: 单URL参数展开多请求
new_findings.contract_quote: 失败证据须能证明对替身的连接未被允许
new_findings.observed: One quoted URL positional argument contains a port list; curl expands it to success HTTP200 then connection failure; anchor OK with and without --
new_findings.origin: existing in 3f3031a; not new in this batch
new_findings.qualification: Conservative glob guard is scoped causal control, not a complete URL parser.
